candidates.snippet: A petrol station in Kyiv was struck by drones that had been manufactured very recently. https://t.co/uZi2zhzgP7
The Mayor of Kyiv reported that a man injured as a result of today's Russian attack was hospitalized in critical condition and unfortunately passed away. https://t.co/NF2o2GjCVQ
The Russians have attacked two more petrol stations in Kyiv. https://t.co/P2v5TqbNIO
